quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on the Timberwolves' defensive intensity and game plan mistakes
quotes.excerpt: we just was making mistakes like game plan mistakes early and didn't have that intensity at the beginning
quotes.quote: we just was making mistakes like game plan mistakes early and didn't have that intensity at the beginning, but second half we brought it. I feel like we played like that the first half we could have probably ended up winning.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on his defensive strategy against Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: just use my length. I know he's a smaller guard, so just trying to give him space
